_comment: This project's settings for the review-loop workflow; the workflow itself is generic. Every field is optional: a missing one uses the workflow's generic default. A worked example is in /discipline:stack (reference/examples/go-react-postgres.md).
name: <PROJECT>
affectedTests: the test files covering the files you changed, and those of modules importing them
targetedChecks: the single test files or packages you touched, and the linter for the touched part of the repo
scriptCheckable: lockfiles (check them through the manifest, `git diff` and targeted searches)
deltaFocus: bugs or regressions introduced, new code without tests (or tests that don't assert the behaviour), and tests weakened or re-pinned to match the code without a spec change or decision behind it
_adapt: ADAPT: set name, gate, fixGate, affectedTests and targetedChecks to this project's commands; add translation catalogues to scriptCheckable if localisation is on
